description: Per measured model: expected saving per run, break-even runs and net saving over expected_runs, with intervals, for one capability and no task. Use when: you know the capability and want its economics on each model the registry measured. Not for: a use-or-not answer for a task (evaluate_capability) or several candidates (compare_capabilities). Input: a capability id; add model to keep one model, and expected_runs with baseline_cost_estimate_usd for an estimate at your scale. Output: ak.roi.v1 with one economics entry per measured model; break-even runs is null when the interval does not show a saving, and your estimate is left out where success is not accepted or your baseline lies outside the measured range.

baseline_cost_estimate_usd.description: What one run of this task costs you today without the capability, in USD.

capability.description: Capability id (ak:publisher:name or ak:publisher:name:x.y.z), ak:// URI or slug.

expected_runs.description: How many times you expect to perform this kind of task.

model.description: The model you run on, e.g. claude-sonnet-5. Savings are reported only for measured models.

name: estimate_roi
title: Estimate return on a capability
